messages:
ana: Heads-up — SOC2 auditor asked for evidence tying recent RBAC changes to key access logs and KMS key usage. They want: list of changed roles, who approved them, and proof keys were not exported. @auditor_jess looping you in. :wave:

mike: copying the PR link and approval thread now. will also pull KMS CloudTrail snippet.

liz: can you confirm which KMS alias was used for inference-prod? I think we rotated the wrapping key on 2025-03-10.

james: yes alias: alias/ri-inference-prod-wrap. rotation completed 2025-03-10T03:12Z. I can grab rotation metadata and key policy diff.

ana (typo correction): ana meant to say @mike — please include the RBAC change ticket IDs (JIRA) and the approve-by list. auditor wants signatures/approvals.

mike: grabbing: JIRA-SEC-3421 (service-account to role-change), JIRA-OPS-4012 (k8s rolebinding prune). approvals: liz, james, ana.

auditor_jess: thanks. For the key export proof we only need CloudTrail records for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey operations and the key policy snapshot. Also if you have a signed manifest for the rotation, attach it. A short narrative mapping each artifact to the control objective would be ideal.

liz: ok will export CloudTrail filter. splunk query I use:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName IN (GenerateDataKey, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Encrypt, Decrypt) resource=arn:aws:kms:*:111122223333:key/1234abcd
| table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters
| sort _time desc
```

mike: exported and uploaded s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/kms-rotation-cloudtrail.csv :thumbsup:

james: attaching key policy diff and rotation manifest to the ticket. manifest includes checksum and rotation-actor signature.

ana (again): auditor also asked for evidence that RBAC changes didn't grant break-glass to external principals. we should show rolebinding snapshots before/after and the reconciliation run results.

oncall: I ran the rolebinding snapshot job on staging and prod. output summary:
```
- staging: 12 bindings changed, no external principals added
- prod: 4 bindings changed, one service-account modified (svc/ingest-processor)
```

oncall: full JSON snapshots uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/rbac-snapshots/{staging,prod}.json

auditor_jess: perfect. Can you also provide the vulnerability triage note for JIRA-SEC-3421? We need to confirm the change wasn't related to a remediation that introduced new risk.

mike: triage note: change was to remove a cluster-admin binding from a deprecated service and replace with a least-priv svc role. no new permissions added. linked CVE-none. added unit tests for RBAC linting rule. uploaded to JIRA-SEC-3421.

liz: one more ask — access logs for the service account around rotation window (2025-03-10T00:00Z..2025-03-11T00:00Z). I can pull from our auth-telemetry.

mike: pulled and redacted PII, uploaded artifact. file: s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/svc-activity-svc-ingest-processor-20250310.csv

ana: auditor wants a short mapping doc. I drafted this mapping: 
- Control A: change control (SOC2 CC6) => JIRA tickets + approvals + PRs
- Control B: key management (ISO 5.1 / SOC2 CC3) => KMS rotation manifest + CloudTrail export + key policy diff
- Control C: access logging => auth-telemetry logs + rolebinding snapshots
- Control D: vuln mgmt => triage notes + regression tests
Please add any gaps and owners.

mike: gaps: need signed snapshot of rolebinding diff (timestamp + sha256) — I'll generate and sign with infra-release key.

james: I can produce the policy attestation PDF and timestamp it in the evidence bundle.

auditor_jess: this is great. If you can produce a 1-page narrative linking each artifact to the control and upload to the evidence bucket, we can close the evidence request. One note: please ensure all objects have ACL=private and access logs enabled on the bucket.

ops-bot: Reminder: evidence upload checklist:
- ACL=private
- Put lifecycle tag: soc2-evidence/2025-Q1
- Enable server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) on uploads
- Add ticket link in object metadata

liz: done for all current uploads. confirmed SSE-KMS in S3 put.

oncall: final question — should we redact user emails from CloudTrail output? auditor_jess?

auditor_jess: redact native emails in public artifacts but include user ARN or principal id. we need chain-of-custody so include identifiers but it's fine to mask email addresses for distribution.

ana: thanks everyone — I'll stitch the one-pager and ship to s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/evidence-bundle-v1.zip and update the auditor ticket. ping if anything else needed. :rocket:
